# Opacity

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Imaging` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class Opacity
```

Whether a pixel — or a whole image, layer or book — carries partial alpha: a level of transparency that is neither fully there nor fully absent. This is the single definition of "partial" the rest of the product reads, including [`VoxelReport`](Nfty.Core.Stats.VoxelReport.md)'s per-pixel count, and it is also what the derived "2D only" flag (Rise) is built from.

```csharp
public static bool HasPartialAlpha(IEnumerable<Image<Rgba32>> images);
```

Whether any image in a sequence contains a partially transparent pixel. Stops at the first one it finds.

**Parameters**

- `images` (`IEnumerable<Image<Rgba32>>`) - The images to scan, in order.

**Returns.** `true` as soon as a partial pixel is found in any image.

### IsPartial(Rgba32) { #m-ispartial-sixlabors-imagesharp-pixelformats-rgba32 }

```csharp
public static bool IsPartial(Rgba32 p);
```

Whether a pixel is partly transparent — neither fully opaque nor fully erased.

**Parameters**

- `p` (`Rgba32`) - The pixel to test.

**Returns.** `true` when the pixel's alpha is neither 0 nor 255.
